Method of Attack: Unauthenticated buffer-related vulnerability allowing buffer over-read
Exploitation via HTTP Host header to exceed buffer limit and leak memory contents including session cookies
Session cookie theft enabling account hijacking and unrestricted access
Attack Vector: HTTP Host header manipulation to vulnerable NetScaler endpoints
Indicators of Compromise: Publicly available proof-of-concept exploit on GitHub
Spikes in exploitation attempts reported by Shadowserver
Leaked 32-65 byte long hex string session cookies in responses
